rationale: The text defines Value Stream Management as a management technique or practice and states its objectives, but does not establish a software offering or implementation. Best-supported binary choice is non-AI, weakly, because scope as a product is unclear.
evidence_spans: Value Stream Management is a management technique or practice that focuses on increasing the flow of business value from customer request to customer delivery.
Its systematic approach to measuring and improving flow helps organizations shorten time-to-market, increase throughput, improve product quality and optimize for business outcomes.
conflict_response: The concern is valid: a business practice and its outcomes do not establish that software performs measurement or improvement. I describe only the stated practice and leave the product/software scope weak and forced rather than infer a tool.
